ghost_suspects.label: C00S
reasons: no bonded partner even via symmetry
ghost_suspects.advice: run ghost_test on it (the delete-and-refine test): 'ghost' is the only deletion licence; 'real' means the density is there - name it (guest solvent e.g. OW with H-bond partners, counter-ion, disorder component), refine it at free occupancy or absorb it in the mask with an acknowledged reason; 'inconclusive' means re-test after the model is more complete, not delete. Never keep chemistry-free atoms just to lower R1, and never delete a 'real' one silently
